_note: NeurIPS 2026 Main Track. The official year-specific style and checklist are required workspace assets, not redistributed by Editio. The profile maps Editio's stable modes onto the official package options and keeps venue policy in data.
name: NeurIPS 2026 Main Track
review: double-blind; acknowledgements are hidden by the official ack environment in submission mode

limits.note: Main Track: 9 content pages for submission and 10 for camera-ready; references, optional technical appendices, acknowledgements, and the mandatory checklist are excluded from the content-page count; PDF maximum 50 MB

notes: use the exact official neurips_2026.sty in the paper root; Editio verifies its bytes but does not redistribute a file whose kit carries no redistribution notice
draft uses the official preprint option, blind uses main-track anonymous submission with line numbers, and publish uses main,final for an accepted camera-ready paper
the content-page label is emitted before acknowledgements, references, optional appendix, and checklist so the doctor can enforce the mode-specific limit from the LaTeX aux file
the checklist is mandatory, follows the optional appendix at the tail of the single PDF, and must have all TODO answers, justifications, and template instruction markers resolved
the official style owns US Letter geometry, 10pt Times text, anonymity, line numbering, natbib, and the acknowledgement environment; do not recreate those settings in front/macros.tex

the plot style uses the official 5.5in text width and the style's 8pt footnote floor as a conservative authoring size; NeurIPS does not prescribe a separate figure-label font in the cited instructions
